segments.text: Hi! I'm Momo, your English buddy.
segments.korean: 안녕! 나는 너의 영어 친구 Momo야.

segments.text: A little practice every day goes a long way.
segments.korean: 매일 조금씩 연습하면 큰 변화가 생겨.

segments.text: Let's try it together. Hello! How are you?
segments.korean: 함께 해 보자. 안녕! 어떻게 지내?

segments.text: Great job! Let's learn, one small step at a time.
segments.korean: 잘했어! 한 걸음씩 함께 배워 보자.
